name: sepia officinalis juice
uses: Uses For the treatment of most jock itch (tinea cruris) ringworm (tinea corporis) athlete's foot (tinea pedis) tinea versicolor For relief of: itching scaling cracking burning redness soreness irritation discomforts which may accompany these conditions.
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use on children under 2 years of age. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation occurs there is no improvement within 2 weeks (4 weeks for ringworm, athlete's foot and tinea versicolor).
